description: Write the operational runbooks: the local-dev runbook (run the SPA + FastAPI locally against the deployed backend resources, per the message-3 'test locally before deploying' requirement) and the iac/README.md DEPLOY runbook (bootstrap -> fetch-ffmpeg -> deploy -> out-of-band secret load -> local test -> validate -> teardown + verify-nothing-lingers). Depends on FEAT-001..005 so every command references real file/script/output names. Grounded in DESIGN.md sections: Local-dev approach, CloudFront signing-key lifecycle (out-of-band put-secret-value), Clean teardown + outputs; and the clear-thinking-app/iac/README.md verify-nothing-lingers pattern. This is NOT the Phase 3 project walkthrough (that is a separate workflow step).
steps: Write projects/video-streaming-app/LOCAL_DEV.md: prerequisites (Python 3.12, AWS creds for the lab account, backend already deployed); `cp frontend/config.local.json frontend/config.json`; export the env vars (INPUT_BUCKET, OUTPUT_BUCKET, TABLE_NAME, ARTIFACT_BUCKET, CF_KEY_SECRET_ARN, CF_DOMAIN, CF_KEY_PAIR_ID) from the CfnOutputs; run the API `uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000`; serve the SPA `python3 -m http.server --bind 127.0.0.1 5500` from frontend/; exercise upload -> status -> playback locally in signed-URL mode; note loopback-only binds (never 0.0.0.0) and that local playback uses signed URLs (rewritten playlist) while production uses signed cookies.

Write projects/video-streaming-app/iac/README.md DEPLOY runbook: the out-of-band RSA keypair generation (openssl genrsa/rsa -pubout, commit only the public PEM); `npx cdk bootstrap aws://678602035067/us-east-1`; `bash scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.sh`; `npx cdk deploy` and the DEPLOY ORDER for the signing key (deploy -> `aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id video/cf-signing-key --secret-string file://cf_private.pem` -> the web ASG replaces its initially-unhealthy instances once the secret is present); point at LOCAL_DEV.md for testing; validate; `npx cdk destroy` (reverse stack order); and a verify-nothing-lingers checklist (CloudFormation stacks gone; no leftover video-* S3 buckets; VideoCatalog table gone; VideoQueue + VideoQueue-DLQ gone; video/cf-signing-key secret gone; /video/web, /video/worker, /video/dlq-marker log groups gone; CloudFront distribution removed; both ASGs at 0 / removed). State explicitly that NO cdk deploy/destroy is run in this workflow -- the commands are for the operator.
Cross-check every command, path, env var, script name, and CfnOutput name in both runbooks against the files actually produced in FEAT-001..005; fix any drift.
acceptance_criteria: LOCAL_DEV.md and iac/README.md exist and reference only real file/script/output names from the implemented packages.
The DEPLOY runbook includes the signing-key deploy order and a verify-nothing-lingers checklist and states no deploy/destroy runs in this workflow.
`npx cdk synth` is still green after the docs change (no code regressions).
verification: cd projects/video-streaming-app/iac && bash scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.sh && npx cdk synth
read LOCAL_DEV.md and iac/README.md and confirm each referenced path/script/env/output exists in the tree
findings: Wrote projects/video-streaming-app/LOCAL_DEV.md (new) and rewrote projects/video-streaming-app/iac/README.md as the full DEPLOY runbook. `npx cdk synth` green for all three stacks (ran fetch-ffmpeg.sh first). All names cross-checked against FEAT-001..005 sources. Confirmed facts for later features: (1) VideoAppStack CfnOutput logical ids = InputBucketName, OutputBucketName, SiteBucketName, ArtifactBucketName, TableName, QueueUrl, DlqUrl, AlbDnsName, CloudFrontDomain, CfKeyGroupId, CfPublicKeyId, CfKeySecretArn (app_stack.py L432-444). (2) Web-tier env var names: INPUT_BUCKET, OUTPUT_BUCKET, ARTIFACT_BUCKET, TABLE_NAME, CF_KEY_SECRET_ARN, CF_DOMAIN, CF_KEY_PAIR_ID (public-key id, NOT key-group id), PLAYBACK_MODE (cookie|signed-url), AWS_REGION, MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES, CF_SIGNING_KEY_FILE (local-only). Launch-template placeholders in app_stack.py use @@NAME@@ substitution writing /etc/video-web.env. (3) Deterministic names: buckets video-{input|output|site|artifacts}-678602035067-us-east-1 (suffix={account}-{region}); table VideoCatalog; queues VideoQueue + VideoQueue-DLQ; secret name video/cf-signing-key (created empty by DataStack); log groups /video/web, /video/worker, /video/dlq-marker. (4) Secret ARN pattern arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:678602035067:secret:video/cf-signing-key. (5) Signing-key deploy order documented: deploy -> put-secret-value -> web ASG unhealthy instances turn healthy/replaced; /health returns 503 until key loaded. (6) Local playback = signed URLs via rewritten-playlist endpoint GET /videos/{video_id}/playlist.m3u8; prod = signed cookies. (7) frontend/config.json is gitignored, produced locally via `cp config.local.json config.json`. Note: the FEAT-005 VPC-origin SG AWS-doc confirmation is owned by FEAT-005 and was not independently re-verified here; synth passing confirms cloudfront.VpcOrigin resolves in the pinned aws-cdk-lib. No cdk deploy/destroy run.
